args.title: Corvid Packaging: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Combined Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Corvid Packaging newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026," its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• Newsletter: Corvid Packaging's latest newsletter spotlights warehouse automation in 2026, linking to a feature article and a companion piece tailored to the reader's company.
• Article (blog.corvid.example/2026/warehouse): Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece (insights.corvid.example): The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
